rationale: The agent verified the user via a matching email before accessing account data. It reviewed the user’s orders with read-only tools, correctly identified the delivered order containing the T-shirt, and checked product variants/availability. Before making any change, it clearly stated the exact exchange (red XXL to black XL, cotton, crew neck) and the price difference to be charged to the user’s on-file PayPal, and obtained explicit user confirmation. It then executed the exchange via the appropriate tool and provided next steps (return instructions via email). No actions were taken on another account, no unsupported claims are evident given the tool outputs (with minor truncation), and there was no premature write without confirmation. Overall, the flow aligns with the policy and completes the user’s request appropriately.
